definitions.explanation: The state of not having paid taxes, fees, premiums, or other required payments by the due date. A formal/administrative term.

examples.japanese: {税金|ぜいきん}が{未納|みのう}になっている。
{保険料|ほけんりょう}の{未納|みのう}が{続|つづ}くと、{保障|ほしょう}が{受|う}けられなくなる。
examples.english: If non-payment of insurance premiums continues, you won't be able to receive coverage.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}の{未納|みのう}が3か{月|げつ}{以上|いじょう}{続|つづ}いた{場合|ばあい}、{契約|けいやく}{解除|かいじょ}となることがあります。
examples.english: If rent remains unpaid for more than three months, the lease may be terminated.

notes: Part of the {未|み}～ (not yet) prefix pattern: {未納|みのう} (not yet paid), {未払|みはら}い (unpaid), {未着|みちゃく} (not yet arrived). Common collocations: {税金|ぜいきん}の{未納|みのう} (unpaid taxes), {未納分|みのうぶん} (unpaid portion), {未納者|みのうしゃ} (non-payer). Distinguished from {滞納|たいのう} (delinquent payment) — {未納|みのう} is neutral and simply means 'not yet paid,' while {滞納|たいのう} implies willful non-payment or default.
